title: LiveHealth tests slept against the fake store's delay, and test.sh hid each zone's test count
evidence: Six tests in ios/HealthRoadmapTests/LiveHealthTests.swift slept a fixed time to act mid-read against FakeLiveStore.delay, the race PR 1669 removed from testAReadBegunBeforeForgetKeepsNothing_AC2 (lead S32). Each now waits on the fake's readsBegun signal: testALockedOrCancelledReadKeepsTheFile_AC2_AC13, testAReadUnderWayDuringRemovalKeepsNothing_AC2, testARevokedMetricClearsItsOpenPage_CodexR2, testACancelledPageReadIsNotKeptAsEmpty_N1, testACancelledRefreshKeepsTheCards_N1 (its second read gets its own fake store, since the cancelled refresh may leave extra signals buffered) and testTheSheetsAnswerAlwaysReadsAgain_N2. Left as they are: testConnectReadsTheCards_AC4 polls a condition (access read), not a delay; testAnEraseDuringTheReadsHistoryRemovalsLeavesNothing_US56_AC5d waits on the history actor held by a long grouping, with no store delay, so the fake sees nothing to signal; testALockedWakeDoesNotCollapseTheUnlock_N2 waits for the locked read to finish and clear lastWake (LiveHealth.swift:149), after the fake has returned, so no fake signal marks it (still a load race: a read-finished signal from LiveHealth would need a production change). ios/scripts/test.sh now prints each zone's last Executed line (xcodebuild's total) from $LOG; the console filter dropped it. Tests: ios/scripts/test-sh.test.ts (fails on the old script). No production Swift change.
